# Gemma Garriga

> Gemma Garriga leads Applied AI Research at GitHub, working on the AI coding
> systems behind GitHub Copilot. Her team builds the foundations that make AI
> agents practical at scale: evaluation systems that catch quality regressions
> before they reach users, multi-agent architectures that improve task
> completion while keeping token cost in check, and memory and context
> platforms that cut the ramp-up cost of every new session.

Before GitHub, Gemma built machine learning systems and teams in both industry
and academia at Google, Allianz, INRIA, HIIT, and Aalto University. She is a
co-founder of Parlapp, a former venture advisor at AV8 Ventures, and a fellow
of Deeptech Labs.

Canonical site: https://gcgarriga.github.io/

## Topics

Applied AI research, AI agents, large language model evaluation, AI coding
assistants, multi-agent systems, post-training, model cascades, machine
learning interpretability, AI developer workflows.

## Projects

- [KVLens](https://github.com/gcgarriga/KVLens): a from-scratch PyTorch case study of KV-cache eviction strategies on Gemma 4
- [baremetal-ai-agent](https://github.com/gcgarriga/baremetal-ai-agent): a tiny framework-free AI agent in Python — raw LLM calls, tool use, streaming, trajectories, replay, and evals
- [repo-radar](https://github.com/gcgarriga/repo-radar): evidence-backed code taste reviews for repositories, as a GitHub Copilot CLI skill and reviewer subagent
- [gspec](https://github.com/gcgarriga/gspec): a minimal spec-driven development skill for GitHub Copilot CLI
- [model-cascade-playbook](https://github.com/gcgarriga/model-cascade-playbook): case studies for designing model cascades that route between small and large models on cost, confidence, and evaluation tradeoffs
- [the-butterfly-effect](https://github.com/gcgarriga/the-butterfly-effect): abstract images generated from the real internals of GPT-2 — weights, attention, activations, loss surface, and embedding geometry

## Ventures

- [Parlapp](https://www.parlapp.net/) — Co-Founder: a marketplace for short, live voice exchanges between people who have something to share and people who want to learn. Built in Paris; went through the AWS Startup Loft Accelerator in 2021.
- [AV8 Ventures](https://av8.vc/) — Venture Advisor: investments and due diligence, and direct work with early-stage founders on AI and data strategy, team structure, and product-market fit.
- [Deeptech Labs](https://dtl.vc/) — Fellow: supporting startups building deeptech technology from first idea to shipped product.

## Speaking

Gemma speaks about shipping AI products, the teams that build them, what
AI-first culture means, and what gets lost between research and product.

- INSEAD Global AI Forum Series (INSEAD, 2025) — AI for developers: how applied research shapes the tools that millions of engineers use every day
- ICON Innovation Week, Women in Tech (ICON, 2025)
- Keynote, Women in Data Science (Swiss Re Centre for Global Dialogue, Zurich)
